reconcile.note: John Gill takes 'cut off' as simply another phrase for the civil penalty of death, so Exodus 31:14 names one sentence, not two.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Jacob Milgrom argues that karet is a distinct divine penalty of extirpation, categorically different from the human death sentence the courts carry out.

sides.snippet: that soul shall be cut off from among his people
sides.verseText: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore; for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

sides.snippet: The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.
sides.verseText: Yahweh said to Moses, The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.
